rationale: Priyal brings hands-on data warehouse and analytics automation expertise (SQL, Python, Jupyter) while Jinal is applying machine learning and data science to drive business outcomes at their startup. They share core competencies in data analytics and Python, but Jinal's co-founder perspective on ML-driven products could benefit from Priyal's production data engineering experience—a natural pairing for exploring how to scale data infrastructure for AI applications.
intro_message: Priyal Panda, meet Jinal Thakker — both deep in data and Python, but Jinal's building ML products at Second Axis AI while Priyal specializes in the data warehouse and automation layer that powers them.
